$comment: Concept-page index allowlist (PRD R4'). This committed file IS the index state:
a /concepts/<slug> page is indexable (robots-indexable, in the sitemap, DefinedTerm
+ BreadcrumbList JSON-LD emitted) if and only if its slug appears in `slugs` below,
OR it has a human-approved authored body (see src/data/concepts-authored-manifest.json).
A build NEVER flips a page's index state — only a commit to this file or the manifest does.
The >=5-dated-evidence floor runs ONLY in the candidate-proposal script
(scripts/knowledge/propose_concept_allowlist.mjs), which prints proposed diffs and never
writes here; a human applies them. Initial 19 slugs approved at the 2026-07-04 R18
sitting (bead sjai-oha). Expansion beyond this list requires R14 evidence.
